audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Ornn Level 6, but the content why for that row, spikes[1], the mid/late prose and the packet levelChart all say Akali owns 6.
audit.why: Perfect Execution's first cast leaps and the recast dashes through and executes; the two-part dash hops Ornn's telegraphed Searing Charge commit. Nothing in Ornn's kit answers it at 6.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side and win[4] flipped to Akali as a matched pair, rating dropped to 4/10, and phases[4].why rewritten to state why.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why was boilerplate ('Akali's ultimate changes the math too') and named nothing.
audit.why: Perfect Execution is 120/90/60 and its recast executes. That is the spike, and it is hers.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now names Perfect Execution, the two-part dash and the execute; dontsFull[0].d gives the 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The shroud interaction was described only as 'untargetable inside'. Assassin's Mark's auto-attack reset tell was absent entirely. dosFull[1] ('Build MR') and dontsFull[1] ('Get Q-poked down') both carried bodies copied from the trading lines and never addressed their own headings.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud makes her unselectable by spells and attacks for 20s at rank 1, so Searing Charge's terrain knockup whiffs into it. Assassin's Mark empowers her next attack — the wind-up, not the ability cast, is the cue to step back. Five Point Strike costs 110 energy at rank 1, so walking out of range drains her.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d rewritten with the real names, the 20s and the 110 energy.

audit.whatIsWrong: tradeGood used 'his answer' for Akali and called the knockup a Q effect.
audit.why: The knockup is Searing Charge (E) colliding with terrain; the Q pillar is the terrain it needs.
audit.corrected: tradeGood restated with the real sequence and correct pronoun.

edits.before: Call of the Forge God re-engages a whole fight — and your forge prints item leads. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Akali's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Perfect Execution's two-part dash hops your telegraphed Searing Charge and the recast executes you through Bellows Breath — do not all-in at 6.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Akali must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: At 3 she shrouds the moment you commit Searing Charge — the knockup whiffs and she resets the trade from inside the smoke.

edits.before: - Akali Twilight Shroud: matchup-defining — Untargetable inside. Fight when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Twilight Shroud: 20s at rank 1, unselectable inside — engage only once it is down. - Assassin's Mark: her empowered auto is the wind-up tell, step back on that, not on the cast. - Your R: kill windows only.

edits.before: Untargetable inside. Fight when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Shroud is 20s at rank 1 and she is unselectable inside — commit on its cooldown.

edits.before: Q the pillar behind Akali, E-dash through it for the knockup when his answer is down, and W-brittle the trade for the proc.
edits.after: Mercury's Treads plus one MR item blunts her Five Point Strike poke and takes the sting out of Perfect Execution at 6.

edits.before: That is Akali's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Perfect Execution executes low targets on a 120s cooldown — get MR before contesting 6.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Five Point Strike costs 110 energy at rank 1 — step out, she runs dry.

edits.before: E-dashing with no terrain in the line — no knockup means you delivered yourself to his combo for free.
edits.after: Inside the smoke she is unselectable, so your Searing Charge knockup whiffs and you eat the reset combo.

edits.before: Q the pillar behind Akali, E-dash through it for the knockup when his answer is down, and W-brittle the trade for the proc.
edits.after: Drop the Q pillar behind Akali, Searing Charge into it for the knockup while Twilight Shroud is down, then W to Brittle her.

notes: Left the rest of the level chart alone: the packet chart disagrees with rows 2, 3 and 6, but the two layers agree with each other and the content whys support what is on disk, so only the Level 6 row — where the content layer contradicted itself — was flipped. Following the mirror audit, nothing here claims Volcanic Rupture grounds or denies Shuriken Flip or Perfect Execution; Riot's text does not say so. Whether Twilight Shroud's unselectability also drops an already-airborne Searing Charge knockup is not in the kit text and is not asserted.
